svg.title: VarMQ multiple queues with round-robin selection
svg.desc: Three empty queues are bound to one worker with concurrency 2 and the RoundRobin strategy. Producers add jobs to all three queues and signal the event loop. The Queue Manager picks the next queue in turn: Queue 1, then Queue 2, both workers become busy, and the remaining jobs wait. Each time a worker finishes, its signal lets the event loop dispatch one more job, continuing the rotation with Queue 3 and Queue 1. When Queue 2 is empty the Queue Manager skips it and moves on to Queue 3. Once every queue is empty, later signals find nothing to do and the event loop waits.
